**Finding: LD — compliant (preferred position met).**

The agreement contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated sum, or early-termination fee:

- **Section 14 (p0079)** — Client may elect to terminate; services simply run to the last day of the following month, with no termination fee or accelerated payment.
- **Section 13 (p0078)** — natural-term non-renewal on 30 days' notice, fee-free (reviewed under RENEWAL, not double-flagged here).
- **Section 5 (p0045)** — the "$\_\_\_\_ per month" floors are recurring minimum charges for services provided, not sums triggered by termination or breach; Section 6 (p0047) only removes them from the dispute mechanic and does not make them stipulated damages.
- **Section 7 (p0049)** — the anti-spam covenant is a bare prohibition with no per-message or fixed penalty against Client.
- **p0077** — the only monetary cap runs in our favour, limiting TrueLink's liability.

No redline proposed. Watch-item for negotiation: resist any later-inserted termination fee, and if one is unavoidable, cap it at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.
